posts.title: Discovery: you cannot protect what you cannot see.
posts.excerpt: Before you can secure identities, you have to know they exist. In practice, many organizations cannot produce a complete list of their service account

posts.title: Accountability: every identity needs an owner.
posts.excerpt: Ownership means a specific, named person is responsible for an identity: why it exists, what it can access, and when it should be retired.

posts.title: Why an AI agent should have its own identity, not borrow yours.
posts.excerpt: It is tempting to let an agent run with a human's account or a shared key. It is also a mistake.
